def state(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:

            r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)

    return out
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':18,'col':36}])
print('after dot3:', state(current_frame))
